origin.source: Discrete epsilon-completion programme, 2026-09-10. Registered before implementation as a general certification protocol in Information Discrete Mathematics.

claim_boundary: This is a fail-closed protocol definition, not a theorem that beta_K exists for every problem, target norm or Navier-Stokes state.
honest_caveats: Coq closure 2026-09-11: mechanizes the STRUCTURAL fail-closed property only -- the gate is a function of an optional dependent Certificate {beta : Q | delta_K+beta<=eps}, so it is type-theoretically impossible for it to return ACCEPT without an actual proof witness; None always yields HOLD. Does NOT prove beta_K is ever attainable for a real omitted-information tail (that is PROP-EPSC-04's analytic content, separate and still open). Tier deliberately left at Definition since the mechanized content confirms a design property, not a new analytic result.
